import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()
    
    # Initialize rejection reason column
    orders["_rejection_reason"] = None
    
    # R1: customer_id not present in ref_customers
    valid_customers = set(ref_customers["customer_id"])
    mask_r1 = orders["_rejection_reason"].isna() & ~orders["customer_id"].isin(valid_customers)
    orders.loc[mask_r1, "_rejection_reason"] = "CUST_UNKNOWN"
    
    # R2: customer status <> 'ACTIVE'
    # Merge with ref_customers to get status
    orders_with_status = orders.merge(
        ref_customers[["customer_id", "status"]], 
        on="customer_id", 
        how="left"
    )
    mask_r2 = (orders["_rejection_reason"].isna() & 
               (orders_with_status["status"] != "ACTIVE"))
    orders.loc[mask_r2, "_rejection_reason"] = "CUST_INACTIVE"
    
    # R3: sku not present in ref_skus
    valid_skus = set(ref_skus["sku"])
    mask_r3 = orders["_rejection_reason"].isna() & ~orders["sku"].isin(valid_skus)
    orders.loc[mask_r3, "_rejection_reason"] = "SKU_UNKNOWN"
    
    # R4: sku discontinued = 1
    # Merge with ref_skus to get discontinued flag
    orders_with_sku = orders.merge(
        ref_skus[["sku", "discontinued"]], 
        on="sku", 
        how="left"
    )
    mask_r4 = (orders["_rejection_reason"].isna() & 
               (orders_with_sku["discontinued"] == 1))
    orders.loc[mask_r4, "_rejection_reason"] = "SKU_DISC"
    
    # R5: allowed_countries validation
    # Merge with ref_skus to get allowed_countries
    orders_with_countries = orders.merge(
        ref_skus[["sku", "allowed_countries"]], 
        on="sku", 
        how="left"
    )
    
    # For each row, check if country is blocked
    for idx in orders.index:
        if pd.isna(orders.loc[idx, "_rejection_reason"]):
            allowed_str = orders_with_countries.loc[idx, "allowed_countries"]
            ship_country = orders.loc[idx, "ship_country"]
            
            # Empty or NULL means all countries allowed
            if pd.notna(allowed_str) and allowed_str.strip() != "":
                allowed_list = [c.strip() for c in allowed_str.split(",")]
                if ship_country not in allowed_list:
                    orders.loc[idx, "_rejection_reason"] = "CTRY_BLOCKED"
    
    # Split into clean and rejects
    orders_clean = orders[orders["_rejection_reason"].isna()].drop("_rejection_reason", axis=1)
    orders_rejects = orders[orders["_rejection_reason"].notna()].copy()
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects.rename(columns={"_rejection_reason": "reason_code"})
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects[["order_id", "customer_id", "sku", "qty", "ship_country", "reason_code"]]
    
    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean,
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects
    }
